headline: YE PULLS UP TO SUPPORT LIL DURK AT FEDERAL TRIAL
body: Ye attended Lil Durk's federal trial in Los Angeles on Thursday, according to footage published by Complex and a first-party post from Doodie Lo. Doodie Lo thanked Ye for showing up during what he called their 'darkest times.' The appearance signals public support for Durk but does not speak to the evidence or outcome of the ongoing case.
